cases.note: Narrowed to the backends that may declare `read: fresh` (the S3 family, OneDrive and SharePoint, the Hugging Face Hub repos, whose hf-hub target changes the file by commit, and GitHub, whose target changes it by a contents PUT): the other three cache reads but stamp no comparable content token, so the mount-time verdict refuses the policy and the workspace never constructs. The bounded control keeps the full list. The github fake is one shared world, and needs no reset: every scenario starts by writing v1, create or update. Its data-v1 repository starts with an empty main, where GitHub would answer 409 for an empty repository. It serves only blobs in current trees, so a read by a superseded sha 404s rather than returning old bytes; the bounded row's second read must therefore be a cache hit.
